description:
UnitySVC runs the official listmonk image together with its own PostgreSQL database in a separate stack for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. listmonk is a self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager: it keeps subscribers and lists, sends campaigns built from templates with personalization, handles opt-in and unsubscribe pages, tracks opens and clicks, and has a REST API. The database and the media you upload are kept in the enrollment's storage, so they survive stopping and restarting the instance.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/admin` with the administrator name and password. listmonk sends mail through an SMTP server that you provide in its Settings; the instance does not include one. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the platform compute cost of both containers while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in the enrollment's storage while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream listmonk documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

REST API with API users and tokens
